title: Target transpose of relative restriction in counit normal form
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], and work in the unbounded derived O-module categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Fix K∈D(O_X) and W⊆U. Write j=U→X, l=W→X, k=W→U, p=W′→X′ and q=W′→W, where W′=X′×_X W. Use the canonical comparisons and pinned adjunctions of [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Put A=R(jf)_*Lj*K, C=Rj_*Lj*K, and c:Lk*Lj*≅Ll* (including the transport k j=l). Define δ:L(lf)*A→Ll*K by the composite (relativeMVComp l f)⁻¹_A, then Ll* of the composite Lf*((relativeMVImageComp j f)⁻¹_{Lj*K}) followed by the f-counit at C, then c⁻¹_C, then Lk* of the j-counit at Lj*K, then c_K. Define τ:L(pf′)*Lg*A→Lp*Lg′*K by the pullback square comparison L(pf′)*Lg*→Lq*L(lf)* at A, then Lq*(δ), then the coefficient comparison Lq*Ll*K→Lp*Lg′*K from q l=p g′. All equality transports are the projection equalities, and all comparison maps are the canonical ones, not unspecified isomorphisms. The adjoint transpose under L(pf′)*⊣R(pf′)_* of the target path of the relative restriction square, with K′=Lg′*K and coefficient map its identity, is τ. The source path is Lg*(relative restriction W⊆U) followed by the W local base-change arrow; the target path is the U local base-change arrow followed by restriction W′⊆U′. Only the target path is asserted to have this normal form; equality to the other path is not an assumption or conclusion. Equal opens, empty opens and zero complexes are included.

proof.text: Apply the composite-base-change-counit identity to the target transpose. Its right side leaves the single open-square base-change and target counit tail uncomputed. Apply the open-square-counit identity to that tail. The proved private restriction_glue lemma combines the two equalities using functoriality and associativity, joining the pulled-back f-counit and U-counit into exactly the displayed normal form.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08HY, 08BV, 08HZ; decomposition into composite base change and single open-square counit.

from.place: Target half of the counit-transpose calculation; coefficient naturality is proved in the parent module.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_restriction_target_counit
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U) :
    let A := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U.ι ≫ f)).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
    let c := relativeMVComp (X.homOfLE i) U.ι ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun t : W.toScheme ⟶ X ↦ derivedPullback t)
        (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i))
    let t := (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f') g).hom.app A ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj A)
        (show pullback.snd g' W.ι ≫ (W.ι ≫ f) =
            (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f') ≫ g by
          rw [← pullback.condition_assoc, Category.assoc, hpull.w, ← Category.assoc]).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (W.ι ≫ f)).inv.app A ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).map
        ((relativeMVComp W.ι f).inv.app A ≫
          (derivedPullback W.ι).map
            ((derivedPullback f).map
                ((relativeMVImageComp U.ι f).inv.app ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) ≫
              (relativeMVAdj f).counit.app
                ((schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K))) ≫
          c.inv.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) ≫
          (derivedPullback (X.homOfLE i)).map
            ((relativeMVAdj U.ι).counit.app ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) ≫
          c.hom.app K) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app K
    ((relativeMVAdj (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f')).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
          (𝟙 _) U).hom ≫
        relativeMVRestriction (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι)
          (pullback.fst g' W.ι) (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) f'
          ((derivedPullback g').obj K)) = t
